dialogs.about: 손녀와 미술책을 펼쳐 놓고 그림을 보며 이야기

lines.en: Come here. Let's look at this art book.
lines.ko: 이리 오세요. 이 미술책을 같이 봐요.

lines.en: Wow! Is this painting famous, Grandma?
I don't know the painter. But I like it.
lines.ko: 화가는 몰라요. 그런데 나는 마음에 들어요.

lines.en: The trees look so realistic to me.
What more do you see in this picture?
A small boat. I want to ride it.
lines.ko: 작은 배요. 저거 타 보고 싶어요.

lines.en: Last week I saw a modern painting too.
Was it abstract, Grandma?
Yes, just colors and lines. Very beautiful.
lines.ko: 네, 색과 선만 있어요. 아주 아름다워요.

lines.en: Thank you, Grandma. I will paint one tomorrow.
lines.ko: 고마워요, 할머니. 저도 내일 하나 그릴 거예요.

dialogs.about: 동네 전시장에서 이웃과 그림 두 점을 보며

lines.en: Hi! Do you come here often?
Hello. I came here last month too.
That painter lived in the last century.
It looks classic. The colors are very soft.
Which painting do you like more?
The bright one. It feels realistic to me.
People call that style impressionism.
Oh, thank you. I don't know much about art.
lines.ko: 아, 고마워요. 나는 미술을 잘 몰라요.

lines.en: That's fine. What do you feel here?
Warm and quiet. I will come again soon.
lines.ko: 따뜻하고 조용해요. 곧 또 올 거예요.
